name: gi-plugins
description: Production AI tooling for Grounded Intelligence clients.

plugins.name: lee-internal-comps
plugins.description: Comps (internal Dealius + external CoStar, lease & sale), demographic and business-key-facts reports, owner-of-record lookup, labor-shed workforce, owner mailing lists, and guided marketing-flyer intake for Lee & Associates Raleigh brokers. Headliners: internal-comps and internal-and-external-comps (Excel + Lee-branded PDF), demographic-summary/-detail and business-key-facts (Lee-branded PDFs), owner-lookup, labor-shed, owner-mailing-list, add-comps, and lee-flyer-brief (guided flyer brief: pulls comps/demographics/owner data, broker curates, provenance-tagged brief, Claude Design handoff). Plus process-mapping: a guided interview that maps any team member's repeatable process into a clean process-map document for GI (CRE = firm context, role-agnostic).
